texts.tagline: Free Part 107 practice test: trick questions
texts.intro: Free practice for the FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot knowledge test. Each question targets a common trap: similar numbers, exceptions, and easily confused words. Answer, then see why the trap works.
texts.home_description: Free Part 107 practice test on your phone. Three-choice trick questions for the FAA Remote Pilot knowledge test, each with the answer, the trap, and the 14 CFR source.
texts.disclaimer: Unofficial practice questions based on 14 CFR Part 107.
texts.disclaimer_more: Not affiliated with the FAA. Rules change: always check the current regulations at eCFR and FAA.gov before you fly or test.
texts.quiz_description: A free 10-question Part 107 practice test made of trick questions. See the correct answer, the trap, and the 14 CFR source right after each answer.
